overall_summary: Initial tests show family relationships and marital bonds perform significantly better than standard shayari or motivation. Specifically, the 'wife/husband emotional video' outperformed all other content by a wide margin, reaching over 1,500 views, while sibling and general shayari content remained under 250 views. Overall sample size is still too small for high statistical confidence, requiring continued testing around high-performing interpersonal dynamics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video 'or5gtaBpRVY' about husband-wife understanding generated 1,538 views, which is nearly 7x higher than the channel average.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more relatable relationship and spouse-oriented micro-stories highlighting unsaid emotional needs.
